sections.title: Experiments
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,status,end_on,plan_locked,reports,issues from v_portfolio order by code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on,code

sections.title: By owner
sections.sql: select * from v_workload order by overdue desc,owner

sections.title: Privacy record reminders
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by code,rule
sections.note: Record checks only. Review access and retention in the operating environment.

sections.title: Latest report by population
sections.sql: select e.code,r.segment,r.start_on,r.end_on,r.source_file,r.source_hash,r.actor from v_latest_reports r join experiments e on e.id=r.experiment_id order by e.code,r.segment

sections.title: Human decisions
sections.sql: select e.code,d.outcome,d.actor,d.rationale,d.created_at from decisions d join experiments e on e.id=d.experiment_id order by d.sequence desc
